cover: Define the technical lead role before you hire

slides.title: List the decisions that stalled
slides.body: Take the last few technical calls that sat unresolved. For each one, write who could have made it and what stopped them.

slides.title: Name the calls the role can make
slides.body: Rewrite or refactor, build or buy, how to divide the system. Agree which of these the new person decides.

slides.title: Settle budget and disagreements
slides.body: Who controls the budget? How does a disagreement between engineers, or with you, get settled?

slides.title: Separate projects from the role
slides.body: A migration or a first hire has an end. Supporting engineers, reviewing spend and owning architecture keep going.

slides.title: Part time or full time?
slides.body: Part time fits occasional decisions. If people are stuck waiting for the next scheduled day, full time may fit better.

slides.title: Check that it's working
slides.body: Decisions are written down with an owner, engineers have someone to escalate to, and the same argument stops coming back.
